nodes.description: Library function Random.toKeccak256 that hashes a string input with keccak256 and returns a uint256.
Library function Random.randNum that derives a pseudo-random number from a seed, block.difficulty and block.timestamp, then takes modulo length.
Library function Random.toHash that hashes a sender address and a secret string with keccak256.
Block timestamp read inside Random.randNum and mixed into the returned pseudo-random value; miner/validator influenceable.
Pseudo-random number generation relying on on-chain values (block.difficulty, block.timestamp) and a caller supplied seed, producing predictable randomness.
Input string parameter of Random.toKeccak256, packed and hashed.
Caller supplied seed parameter of Random.randNum, packed into the hash used for the random value.
Divisor/modulus bound parameter of Random.randNum; zero value causes a revert and its value reveals the range of the random result.
Address parameter of Random.toHash, packed with the secret before hashing.
Secret string parameter of Random.toHash, packed with the sender address before hashing.

edges.reason: The input string parameter flows directly into the keccak256 hashing inside toKeccak256.
The seed parameter is packed into the hash input that determines the returned random value.
The length parameter is used as the modulus operand; a zero length causes a division-by-zero revert.
block.timestamp is read inside randNum and mixed into the result, making the output timestamp dependent and miner influenceable.
randNum produces the predictable pseudo-random output modeled as the weak randomness unsafe operation.
The sender address parameter is packed into the hash input of toHash.
The secret string parameter is packed into the hash input of toHash.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter input only exists to feed Random.toKeccak256 and can be folded into that core function node.
Parameter seed only exists to feed Random.randNum and can be folded into that core function node.
Parameter length only exists to feed the modulus computation in Random.randNum and can be folded into that core function node.
Parameter sender only exists to feed Random.toHash and can be folded into that core function node.
Parameter secret only exists to feed Random.toHash and can be folded into that core function node.
